svg.title: MDA/2-2 accuracy across projection dimensions
svg.desc: Mean probe accuracy across five repeated ORL splits for each row and column output dimension and gallery size. Test-selected maxima are optimistic.
svg.text: Original 112×92 ORL · 5 matched splits per gallery size · unit-L2 projections · paper Fig. 3 stopping rule
Each panel uses the common color scale. Selecting the highest probe cell is optimistic; use the full curve and held-out validation for final model selection.
